# FREE NETWORK Policy Briefs

> > Research-driven policy analysis on economic transition, governance, and development challenges in Eastern Europe and post-Soviet states.

FREE NETWORK publishes policy briefs examining economic reforms, environmental policy, and institutional development across the Baltic-Black Sea region, with particular focus on Ukraine, Belarus, Poland, and other transition economies. The platform features analysis from leading research institutions including SITE and BEROC.

## Key Topics

- Eastern Europe transition economies
- Belarus economic reforms
- Ukraine policy analysis
- European Union directives and integration
- Climate change and energy transition
- COVID-19 pandemic responses
- Corruption and financial crime
- Agricultural subsidies and food security
- Whistleblower protection
- Post-Soviet institutional development
- Poland regional development
- Circular economy transformation
- Natural gas procurement
- Active labor market policy
- Tax havens and offshore data leaks

## Ukraine: Economic Policy and Reconstruction

- [Financial Aid to Ukrainian Reconstruction: Loans Versus Grants](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2022/04/29/ukraine-aid-loans-versus-grants): Ukraine reconstruction aid: concessional loans vs grants compared
- [Indexation Formula for Natural Gas Procurement in Ukraine](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2020/02/10/natural-gas-procurement-ukraine): Ukraine natural gas procurement indexation formula & corruption prevention
- [How to Liberalise EU-Ukraine Trade under DCFTA: Tariff Rate Quotas](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2020/06/04/how-to-liberalise-eu-ukraine-trade-under-dcfta-tariff-rate-quotas): EU-Ukraine DCFTA tariff rate quotas & agro-food trade liberalization
- [Active Labor Market Policy in the Baltic-Black Sea Region](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2024/06/03/active-labor-market-policy): ALMP in Belarus, Lithuania, Poland & Ukraine compared

## Belarus: Economic Transition and Social Policy

- [What Drives Belarus to Be One of the Most Optimistic Nations in Europe?](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2023/03/06/belarus-optimistic-nations-europe): Belarus economic optimism despite sanctions & GDP decline analyzed
- [The Inevitable Social Security Reforms in Belarus](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2016/02/08/the-inevitable-social-security-reforms-in-belarus): Belarus social security, pension & utility subsidy reform analysis
- [Circular Economy in Belarus: What Hinders the Transformation?](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2020/12/14/circular-economy-belarus): Belarus circular economy barriers: company survey results
- [Dreaming of Entrepreneurship or Requiem for a Dream – What Kind of Future Do Parents Envision for Their Children in Belarus?](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2024/11/04/entrepreneurship-belarus-children): Belarus parental attitudes toward children's entrepreneurship explored

## Climate Change and Environmental Policy

- [The Determinants of Renewables Investment](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2017/11/13/determinants-renewables-investment): Renewable energy investment drivers & climate policy examined
- [The Cost of Climate Change Policy: The Case of Coal Miners](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2022/10/10/climate-change-coal): UK coal phase-out costs & miner displacement during Thatcher era
- [Green Concerns and Salience of Environmental Issues in Eastern Europe](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2021/06/07/climate-change-risk-perceptions): Climate change risk perceptions: Eastern vs Western Europe compared
- [Pollution and the COVID-19 Pandemic: Air Quality in Eastern Europe](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2021/02/01/air-quality-eastern-europe): Eastern Europe air quality & PM2.5 pollution during COVID-19 lockdowns

## COVID-19 Pandemic Responses

- [The Swedish Exceptions: Early Lessons From Sweden's Different Approach to COVID-19 – Insights From a SITE-LSE Webinar](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2020/04/27/swedens-different-approach-to-covid-19): Sweden's COVID-19 voluntary compliance approach: SITE-LSE webinar insights
- [Social Distancing and Ethnic Diversity](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2021/12/14/social-distancing-ethnic-diversity): COVID-19 social distancing behavior & ethnic diversity correlation studied

## Corruption, Transparency, and Governance

- [Paradise Leaked: An Analysis of Offshore Data Leaks](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2022/01/31/tax-haven): Pandora, Paradise & Panama Papers offshore data leaks analyzed
- [Whistleblower Protections but no Rewards: EU Commission Proposes a New Directive](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2018/06/26/whistleblower-protections-but-no-rewards-eu-commission-proposes-a-new-directive): EU Commission whistleblower directive proposal analyzed

## Regional Development and Agriculture

- [The Polish 1999 Administrative Reform and Its Implications for Inclusive Regional Development](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2019/03/25/the-polish-1999-administrative-reform-and-its-implications-for-inclusive-regional-development): Poland's 1999 decentralization reform & regional development impact
- [Agricultural Subsidies: The Case of Georgia](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2025/03/17/agricultural-subsidies-georgia): Georgia agricultural subsidies for grapes, apples & hazelnuts examined

## Optional

- [In Memoriam János Kornai: a leading economist of post-socialist transition in the twentieth century has passed away at age 94](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2021/10/22/in-memoriam-janos-kornai): Tribute to János Kornai, transition economics pioneer (1928-2021)
- [Ownership Structure, Acquisitions and Managerial Incentives](https://freepolicybriefs.org/2019/03/18/ownership-structure-acquisitions-and-managerial-incentives): Corporate governance, ownership structures & managerial incentives analyzed
